prompt:

Asset type: V18 website 4:3 handmade finished-drawing illustration, 4K-ready master artwork

Style/medium: Refined traditional colored-pencil and translucent watercolor illustration on tactile cream paper; softly layered graphite, visible hand pressure, subtle pigment blooms, delicate fur strokes and wood grain, storybook-cute but not digitally glossy.
